runtime_target_transport: none: offline, scripted models, no audio and no transport
provider_model_settings: pydantic-ai FunctionModel; ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS=False, so a real provider request raises rather than being made
command_or_scenario_recipe: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GOOGLE_API_KEY=offline-test-placeholder .venv/bin/python -B -c 'import sys, runpy; import pydantic_ai.models as models; models.ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS = False; runpy.run_module(sys.argv[1], run_name="__main__")' tests.test_bench
expected: Paired raw rows, actual request counts, audio-gap distributions and predeclared criteria
actual: The instrument is repaired and tested; no comparative data has been collected. Five counting defects are fixed and pinned by 15 checks against a hand-written fixture: turn merging under a present call root, STT/TTS counted as model requests, zero-model turns dropped from the denominator, repeated tools called repairs, and a quantile that was not nearest rank. The estimated "p90 turn" is deleted.
limitations: Offline and scripted. No real provider accepted these schemas, no audio was synthesised or recognised, and no carrier was involved. Nothing here transfers to a live call.
No A/A-prime/B/C run has been made. Every figure this instrument would produce is still unmeasured, and the fixture is synthetic: it proves the arithmetic, not the pipeline that feeds it.
Repair detection relies on level/statusMessage on Langfuse observations. That mapping is asserted against the fixture, not against a captured live trace.
